objects.description:
During the [AI-Assisted Breach of Mexico's Government Infrastructure](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0064), the adversary tasked Claude Code to scan an internet-facing server at the Mexico Federal Tax Authority for vulnerabilities using Vulmap.(Citation: AI-Mexico-Govt-Breach) 

During the [AI-Assisted Breach of Mexico's Government Infrastructure](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0064), the adversary tasked Claude Code to scan internet-facing devices to detect vulnerabilities.(Citation: AI-Mexico-Govt-Breach)(Citation: AI-Mexico-Govt-Compromise)    
 
During the [AI-Assisted Breach of Mexico's Government Infrastructure](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0064), the adversary requested Claude Code to use the open-source vulnerability scanner Vulmap to aid in scanning activities.(Citation: AI-Mexico-Govt-Breach)
